title: Airport Karen Acts Like A Brat Towards Deputies And Gets Herself Arrested
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On December 30th, 2023. Sheriffs were called to the airport in reference to a woman who was causing a disturbance on the plane. The woman repeatedly kept saying she was in the police force & knew her rights . She was extremely rude and belligerent to the sheriffs, which led to her arrest. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

#news #police #arrest
